This Thursday, SFPlayground is bringing together some of the brightest minds in Industrial AI, Robotics, and Advanced Manufacturing to explore how AI is transforming the way we design, build, and manufacture physical products.

From AI-powered CAD and autonomous quality inspection to intelligent supply chains and factory automation, AI is moving beyond software and into the physical world.

We’re bringing together 3 Y Combinator founders, a seasoned hardware and AI operator, and a venture investor to discuss what it actually takes to bring these technologies from prototype to production.

🎤 Moderator

Varad Mohod — Investor, Zacua Ventures | Robotics, Industrial AI & Manufacturing
